Wealth Roadmap

One path from the red to your own home, step by step. Every step, badge and saving habit earns XP.

Next steps
Side quests

Habits that count in any order. Saving streaks come from the House Builder; the monthly ones reset each month, up to 25 XP a month.

Levels
Badge tokens
How XP works
  • The roadmap is one path of 30 stages in order. Each stage has up to three steps, and every step earns XP: Starter 20, Solid 40, Strong 80, Summit 150.
  • Steps count once you reach their stage, so the path stays in order. A skipped stage earns nothing and costs nothing.
  • Badges and saving habits are side quests. They count in any order.
  • XP you earn stays earned, even if a figure drops later.
  • Twenty levels in five ranks: Groundwork, Shield, Growth, Keys and Freedom.
  • Reach Level 8, Vault Guard, and use Vault-It on 30 different days to claim one free month. We add it to your account by hand.

Illustrative only. Not regulated by the FCA. Not financial advice.

Vaulter, monthly or yearly, is the whole app with the six preset houses. Pioneer, monthly or yearly, is Pro: it adds the Entrepreneur tab, your own 3D house design and the AI house model, early access to new features and roadmap voting, with house builder Level 3 coming. The Lifetime licence (one payment, 100 places, beta testers first) is Pioneer for the life of the service. Household, for up to 8 people, is coming soon.

Manage or cancel my plan
There is no self-service page for plans yet. Email hello@vault-it.co and we will change or cancel it for you.
Appearance and accessibility
Simplified keeps the essentials on screen. Advanced shows every tile and tab. Nothing is deleted either way.
Weekly check-in and phone
Your check-in day. On that day Vault-It shows you your next step. Five minutes is enough.
Add your number to receive a heavily discounted lifetime licence code when Vault-It launches on beta.
Help and app tour
A one-minute look at each tab, or ask a question and browse the FAQs.
Live prices

Crypto prices come from CoinGecko, metals from metals.live, and stocks and funds through Vault-It's own price service. Prices are indicative. Off stops the automatic checks; prices you typed yourself are never changed.

Bank, broker and platform connections
Pro, coming in a future release

Connecting your bank, broker, exchange or platform to bring figures in automatically is planned for Pro in a future release. Nothing is connected today and the app never asks for your bank or exchange details. Add and update your figures yourself in the tabs.

Cloud sync
Checking…
“Upload everything” sends all the data on this device to your account, so it appears when you sign in anywhere else.
Sign-in PIN
Set a 6-digit PIN to sign back in on any device with just your email and PIN, no email code needed. Five wrong tries lock it for 15 minutes (an email code always works).
Privacy and usage sharing

During the beta the app records which screens and features you use, errors and how long you stay, in our own database, to improve it. Never your figures or what you type.

Your data
Download a copy of your data as a file you can keep: your figures and profile (on this device and in your account) and your latest 200 saved versions. Photos, feedback you sent, the beta usage log and technical security records are not in the file; email us for those. You can also delete your account for good below.
Danger zone
Owner and developer tools
Keys are stored in this browser only and sent only to the service they belong to.
